description: This source file defines a React functional component 'DailyContentList' which displays a list of daily content items with calendar integration, scrolling, and selection logic. It manages state for calendar views, pagination, and selected items, and interacts with external controllers and utility functions. It appears to be a key component in a web application for viewing and managing daily content entries.

methods.description: Handles pagination to load more items at the bottom of the list.

methods.description: Handles pagination to load more items at the top of the list.

methods.name: onListItemDidBecomeVisible
methods.description: Callback invoked when a list item becomes visible; updates calendar view accordingly.

methods.description: Handles item click events, triggering selection and UI updates.

methods.description: Handles clicks on template (empty) sections to create new notes.
